name: Rip N Ship Simulator
storyline:
Start from humble beginnings as an aspiring card breaker with a simple basement setup, a small collection, and almost no audience. Go live, open packs for customers, manage incoming orders, and entertain viewers while gradually building a following and reputation.

As the channel grows, expand the operation by collecting and grading cards, selling pulls, organizing a growing collection, upgrading the streaming setup, and unlocking new rooms and stages. Run giveaways and auctions, chase rare cards, and work toward turning a small-time card-breaking stream into a thriving rip-and-ship operation.
summary: Build your own card-breaking empire in Rip N Ship Simulator. Open packs for viewers, manage live orders, grow your simulated stream, collect and grade cards, run giveaways and auctions, upgrade your setup, and create custom cards, packs, and complete sets.
